Web App Development $15K

You can get a web app developed through Everbuilt Studio's Platform package at $15K. This package includes web apps, SaaS MVPs, and mobile apps, and you will own the site outright, including code, content, and domain.

How it Works for Web App Development

The Platform package is designed for complex projects, including web apps, SaaS MVPs, and mobile apps. Your web app will be hosted on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, with $0/month hosting fees.

What You Get and Costs

The Platform package is $15K, with a 50% deposit required upfront and the balance due at launch. After 90 days of free care, you can opt for care plans at $295/month or $595/month, cancelable at any time.

FAQ

What kind of support do I get after launch? You get 90 days of free care after launch, and then you can opt for care plans at $295/month or $595/month. How much does hosting cost? Hosting is $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub. What is included in the Platform package? The Platform package includes web apps, SaaS MVPs, and mobile apps.

To get started with your web app development project, you can visit our contact page to learn more about the Platform package and how to move forward with your project.
